note: Every StateKind of crates/types needs a line here, or the site build fails.
Burning: Deals a share of the hit's damage at the start of each of the target's turns.
Chill: Slows the target; enough Chill turns into Freeze.
Freeze: Hard control: the target skips its turn.
Bleeding: Deals a share of the hit's damage at the start of each of the target's turns.
Shock: The target takes more damage from the next hits while it lasts.
Stun: Hard control: the target skips its turn.
Penetration: Lowers the target's effective armor against physical packets.
